title: Parallel Characters
skills: identify meaningful similarities and differences between parallel characters
analyze how paired characters illuminate each other's traits and choices
compare character motivations, conflicts, and development
explain how parallel characters contribute to theme and narrative meaning
alignment_note: Introduces parallel characters as a literary technique in which two characters are intentionally constructed with meaningful similarities or contrasts. Supports comparative character analysis, characterization, thematic interpretation, and evidence-based literary analysis across high school English courses.
